conventions.given_frame: a given type's STEP is in its documented frame; a placement's local_to_world places it
conventions.graded_holes: concave cylindrical steps of 300 degrees or more, radius up to 12 mm, at least 0.4 mm deep; coaxial steps on one axis line are one hole
conventions.hole_classes: seat: a bearing's outer ring or a servo's rear ring sits in it; pin_bore: a dowel pin passes through it; horn: a part of the servo's output link, on its output axis or bolt circle against the horn face; screw: a screw passes through it; other: nothing sits in it at the rest pose
conventions.kind_frame: a kind's B-rep is in its own frame; a tag's local_to_world places it at the rest pose

frame: the hand's assembly frame at its rest pose (configuration Z); every hinge angle is 0 there

mass.rule: made: B-rep volume x density; given: the data-page mass; per link in mechanism.links

conventions.chain: a digit's chain lists its links from the palm outwards (PALM excluded); a finger's bar link closes its loop and is in no chain
conventions.hinge_axis: the positive sense: a servo hinge turns by the servo's +z when its case is on the palm-side link (parent, case_side parent), by -z when on the tip-side link; a pin hinge parallel to its finger's third hinge, the same sense
conventions.limits: from the rest pose, every other independent hinge at rest and each finger's distal hinge following its loop, until two parts of the digit or the digit and the palm meet
conventions.tip: the sensing-surface centre of the digit's tactile module, carried by the module

loops.branch: the assembly branch of the STEP pose (the link pin on the same side of the line base pivot - distal hinge as at Z), followed continuously
the assembly branch of the STEP pose (the link pin on the same side of the line base pivot - distal hinge as at Z), followed continuously
the assembly branch of the STEP pose (the link pin on the same side of the line base pivot - distal hinge as at Z), followed continuously

HUB.mass_basis: one component's vendor figure, the rest of the solid by volume x nominal density (an estimate)
HUB.name: power and bus hub board

tip_local.rule: the area centroid of the sensing surface, projected onto it
the area centroid of the sensing surface, projected onto it

samples.located: the located marks of the delivered photo set: the location rule with the mesh-check marks, where a sample at an edge keeps its mark only if that edge is located in the photographs in which its edge class can be read; a sample enters the shape distance only where it is located

units: mm, g, rad (degrees where a key says deg)
